observation: The self-shape harness described evidence discipline more strongly than it practiced it. Before PR #32 it planned with a generic hard-coded goal, used the same self-shape actor to plan and approve, recorded validation duration as 0 without measuring it, and treated deterministic blind-spot completion as the only review artifact while the complete PR diff was not preserved separately. The first PR #32 self-run then caught a real shell syntax defect at bash -n before governance ran. After the fix, the next run governed its own three-file PR diff successfully and reported the real PR goal, a distinct approval fixture, measured validation duration, a generated code-review prompt, and lossless raw-diff evidence without claiming that CI itself performed independent human approval or correctness review.

evidence.summary: At base commit 52c43e2904dfbf524136b11a5dff39ed3eb5a109, tools/self-shape-dogfood.sh used one actor for workflow plan/approve, a fixed generic goal, --duration-ms 0, and no separately persisted complete raw-diff or explicit external correctness-review boundary.

evidence.command: GitHub Actions CI run 31243789847: Agent-loop shapes itself
evidence.summary: The first PR #32 iteration failed at the package-owned bash -n preflight with an unmatched quote in the modified self-shape runner. The edit and governed lifecycle were skipped, proving the harness rejected its own invalid implementation before producing workflow evidence.

evidence.summary: The corrected self-shape runner passed its mechanical self-edit and governed the real PR #32 diff. Final output recorded base 52c43e2904dfbf524136b11a5dff39ed3eb5a109, CI merge head 0f54bead6236f1ced41cf6ba41283b4d6479abb6, three changed files, goal 'PR #32: dogfood: make self-shaping evidence observational', approval fixture 'voku', observed composer-ci duration 43618 ms, and learning decision no_durable_learning. Final blind-spot status was ok, workflow close passed, and agent-loop verify reported no drift.

All three composer-ci matrix jobs passed. The self-shape job itself ran 339 PHPUnit tests with 1479 assertions, PHPStan reported no errors, and the project PHPStan-rule and agent-discipline dogfood checks passed.

evidence.summary: The installed-consumer lifecycle and installed first-party asset dogfood remained green after the self-shape evidence changes.

The successful self-shape run uploaded 35 evidence files as artifact self-shape-0f54bead6236f1ced41cf6ba41283b4d6479abb6, size 38473 bytes, with archive digest sha256:54a98139564a5b96393234db110faacd86bbbedce64ba6036e39d146853e701c. The upload contract includes self-shape JSON evidence, the complete raw diff, recall/history, session state, and run manifest.

hypothesis: A self-governing coding-agent workflow is only useful when its evidence is observational rather than ceremonial. Harness-generated values must be measured or explicitly labeled as fixtures, bounded review input must not be confused with independent review, and complete source/diff evidence must remain available outside compressed prompts. Otherwise self-dogfood can make its own governance look stronger than the proof actually supports.
validated_conclusion: Self-shape CI must derive the task goal and changed scope from the real pull request, preserve the complete raw diff, record observed validation duration, distinguish planner identity from the approval fixture, label that fixture as non-independent human evidence, and keep generated code-review input separate from an external correctness judgment. A self-run may prove deterministic workflow mechanics and close gates, but it must not self-issue stronger approval or review claims. Durable MEMORY promotion remains a separate reviewed action.
